finding: Eliminated all four odd numerator coefficients from the original septic synthesis question using strict compact convex separation and an exact five-atom moment support argument. An eligible box has a common exact-degree-seven numerator iff a single even coefficient triple in its explicit open root-gap polyhedron satisfies every one of two explicit affine divided-difference inequality families: (i) five positive nodes with alternating actual odd signs and (ii) four positive nodes with signs (-,+,-,+) plus the infinity atom. Their weights are the inverse t|O(t)| times the absolute Vandermonde derivatives. Every nontrivial circuit must include a backward crossing within a global odd-root band. Singleton rows at zero or odd roots are strictly positive on the root-gap polyhedron, and compactness pays the uniform strictness; no fixed numerator profile, sample, or assumed earlier unreviewed theorem is used.
